final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT c.district_id AS d, di.A3 AS r, COUNT(*) AS n FROM client c JOIN district di ON di.district_id = c.district_id GROUP BY c.district_id, di.A3), s2 AS (SELECT r, SUM(n) AS t FROM s1 GROUP BY r), s3 AS (SELECT s1.d AS d, s1.r AS r, s1.n AS n, CAST(s1.n AS REAL) / s2.t AS q FROM s1 JOIN s2 ON s1.r = s2.r), s4 AS (SELECT SUM(n) AS tot FROM s3) SELECT s3.d, s3.r, s3.n, s3.q, CAST(s3.n AS REAL) / s4.tot AS share FROM s3 JOIN s4 ON s4.tot IS NOT NULL ORDER BY share DESC LIMIT 10
